widgets_values:
Choose if you want
1 = Track
2 = Track + Pose
3 = Canny + Pose
4 = Input CN Video

Enable Disable Reference Frame
1 = Enable
2 = Disable

When setting up the start frame there different advantages of each option.
- Option 1 = If you want as much adherence to the background image.
- Option 2 = If you don"t want thje actor to appear in the shot right away, but make them enter the frame.
- Option 3 = If you want WAN to generate the overall image through describing it through the textprompt.
If you only want to use a textprompt to decribe the setting, you can disable an image input by chossing option 2.
As this workflow can get memory and calculation time heavy, we began saving the CONTROL IMAGES output at some point to save time and memory in this section.

Pick Start Frame
1 = Actor + Background Image
2 = Background Image Only
3 = NO Startframe
If you notice gray or dark outlines around the actor, increase the value to reduce the actor's mask.

nodes.title: To add another iteration
widgets_values:
1. Select the Iteration subgraph
2. Copy it with Ctrl+Shift+V (this keeps the wires connected)
3. Find the output of your previous Iteration → drag it to the "previous_gen" input on your new one
4. Change Iteration Number to match its position (2nd iteration = 2, 3rd = 3, etc.)

Repeat for as many iterations as you need!

To save time, you can save the output from the control group and re-upload it here, then select option 8 in the switch.

It's worth taking that step, when you have a long clip.

The recommended step count is 8!

For a quick preview, you can use a lower number like 2 — the animation should still remain consistent.

nodes.title: Model download links
widgets_values:
Switch between fp8 and GGUF model loaders.
- GGUF is ideal for low VRAM. FP8 is faster.
- Download only the models you need.
- If you switch models after they are loaded, OOM errors are common. Restarting Comfy is then necessary.

nodes.title: Model download links
widgets_values:

- Wan2.1_14B_VACE-Q5_1.gguf
